name: Public APIs
description: The community's master list of free APIs, sorted by category — the first place to look when you need a service for a side project.

name: Open-Meteo
description: Free weather forecasts and historical climate data for any coordinate, with no API key and no signup.

name: NASA Open APIs
description: Astronomy Picture of the Day, Mars rover photos and near-Earth objects, all on a demo key that works out of the box.

name: PokéAPI
description: Every Pokémon, move, ability and sprite in one free REST API — a favourite first API for learning to fetch data.

name: REST Countries
description: Flags, capitals, currencies, languages and populations for every country on Earth, as clean JSON.

name: TheCatAPI
description: Random cat photos, breed lookups and vote endpoints — a light-hearted way to test image handling.

name: Dog CEO
description: Random dog pictures by breed, hosted over HTTPS with no key required and no rate-limit drama.

name: Open Library
description: Search millions of book records, covers and authors from the Internet Archive's open catalogue.

name: Wikipedia REST API
description: Article summaries, random pages, page images and full-text search straight from Wikipedia.

name: Datamuse
description: A word-finding API for rhymes, synonyms and related terms — a poet's, or a word game's, toolbox.

name: Free Dictionary API
description: Definitions, phonetics and audio pronunciations for English words, with no key and no signup.

name: Frankfurter
description: Reference exchange rates from the European Central Bank, published daily and served as simple JSON.

name: CoinGecko
description: Live prices, market caps and historical charts for thousands of cryptocurrencies on a free tier.

name: ExchangeRate.host
description: Currency conversion and historical rates with a free key that never asks for a credit card.

name: The Color API
description: Turn a hex value into names, harmonies and schemes, or generate a full palette from a single colour.

name: DiceBear
description: Generate identicon-style profile pictures as SVG or PNG straight from a URL, in dozens of styles.

name: Lorem Picsum
description: Placeholder images at any size, with blur and grayscale options, from nothing but a URL.

name: Unsplash API
description: Search and download millions of free high-resolution photographs, with attribution built into the rules.

name: Pexels API
description: Free stock photos and videos through a simple keyed REST API with a generous monthly quota.

name: Random User Generator
description: Fake user profiles with names, photos and addresses — perfect for seeding a UI with believable test data.

name: JSONPlaceholder
description: Fake posts, comments, todos and users for prototyping a front end before the real backend exists.

name: httpbin
description: A tiny service that echoes your request back — headers, redirects, auth, cookies and all.

name: Open Trivia DB
description: Thousands of multiple-choice questions with categories and difficulty, free for quizzes and bots.

name: TheMealDB
description: Recipes, ingredients and meal photos by category, cuisine, or a single random pick.

name: TheCocktailDB
description: Cocktail recipes, glassware and ingredient images for a home-bar app or a quick lookup.

name: Open Food Facts
description: A crowd-sourced database of packaged food: barcodes, ingredients, nutrition and label photos.

name: Open Brewery DB
description: A free, key-less directory of breweries searchable by city, state, country and type.

name: Art Institute of Chicago
description: The museum's public collection — artworks, artists, images and descriptions — as open data.

name: The Met Collection
description: Search the Metropolitan Museum's objects and pull high-resolution public-domain images.

name: OpenSky Network
description: Live aircraft positions and flight states collected by a volunteer network of receivers.

name: Where the ISS at?
description: The International Space Station's current latitude, longitude and altitude, refreshed every second.

name: USGS Earthquake Feed
description: Query real earthquakes by magnitude, place and date range from the USGS catalogue.

name: Nager.Date
description: Public holidays for over a hundred countries, by year, as plain JSON.

name: WorldTimeAPI
description: The current time, timezone and UTC offset for a place or an IP address, with no key.

name: Zippopotam.us
description: Postal code lookups that return the places, coordinates and timezone hiding behind them.

name: Nominatim
description: OpenStreetMap's geocoder: turn an address into coordinates, or coordinates back into an address.

name: Wayback Machine API
description: Ask whether a URL has been archived, and get back the closest snapshot to any date.

name: Hacker News API
description: Stories, comments and user profiles from Hacker News — read-only, key-free and instant.

name: GitHub REST API
description: Repositories, issues, releases, commits and users — the API behind most developer dashboards.

name: Lichess API
description: Games, puzzles, ratings and live board streams from the free open-source chess server.

name: Deck of Cards
description: Shuffle, draw and deal a virtual deck — the simplest way to add cards to a side project.

name: Rick and Morty API
description: Characters, locations and episodes from the show, with images and filters on every endpoint.

name: Star Wars API
description: The classic Star Wars dataset — people, planets, films and starships, all with stable IDs.

name: Studio Ghibli API
description: Films, characters, locations and species from Studio Ghibli's catalogue of animated features.

name: SpaceX API
description: Launches, rockets, capsules and Starlink data compiled from public sources and kept current.

name: PubChem
description: Chemical compounds, properties and structures from the NIH's enormous public database.

name: World Bank Data
description: Development indicators for every country going back decades, as free and open data.

name: Hugging Face Inference
description: Run hosted open-source models — text, images and audio — from a single REST call.

name: LibreTranslate
description: Open-source machine translation you can call from an app, or self-host and run for free.

name: IP-API
description: Look up a visitor's country, city, ISP and coordinates from their IP address.

name: ipwho.is
description: Free IP geolocation with no key, no signup and a JSON-first response built for browsers.

name: QR Code API
description: Generate QR codes as PNG, SVG or EPS just by building a URL — no key and no server needed.

name: RSS to JSON
description: Turn any RSS feed into JSON so a browser can read it without tripping over CORS.

name: Agify
description: Guess a person's age from their first name, with country-level breakdowns and sample sizes.

name: Nationalize
description: Guess the likely nationality behind a first name, returned with probability scores per country.

name: Genderize
description: Predict the gender associated with a first name, from a large aggregated international dataset.

name: Cat Facts
description: A random cat fact on every request, plus breed lists and pagination for browsing.

name: Useless Facts
description: Random trivia delivered as JSON or plain text, with a daily-fact endpoint for a steady drip.

name: Advice Slip
description: Random pieces of advice, searchable by word, each with a stable slip ID you can cite.

name: ZenQuotes
description: Inspirational quotes and a today's-quote endpoint, free for non-commercial projects.

name: Yes No
description: Answers yes, no or maybe, each with an animated GIF to match. That is the whole API.

name: Kanye Rest
description: One random Kanye West quote per request, plus an optional timestamp parameter.

name: Fruityvice
description: Nutrition facts for dozens of fruits, each filed under a genus, family and order.
